chunks: Al-‘Alā’ narrated from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abū Ja‘far عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about two men who married two women, and this one was brought the wife of that one, and that one the wife of this one. He said: “This one observes the ‘iddah from this one, and this one from this one; then each one returns to her husband.”
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if two wives are mistakenly exchanged between two husbands?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding mistaken marital exchange between two couples. Imam Abū Ja‘far عليه السلام states that each woman must observe the waiting period from the man with whom the mistaken marital relation occurred, after which she returns to her lawful husband.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4467 - Al-'Ala' narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who reported from Abu Ja'far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as):

I asked Imam (as) about two men who married two women, but each man was mistakenly given the wife of the other.
Imam (as) said: "Each woman must observe the waiting period (iddah) from the other man, and then they may return to their rightful husbands."
